headers.comment: Default: revalidate every time. The page itself is served at / (not /index.html) because cleanUrls is on, so a rule written against /index.html never matches and the page silently keeps Firebase's 1-hour default - which is how a deploy can appear not to have happened.
Next emits content-hashed filenames here, so these can never go stale.
Acceptance photographs change rarely and are large; a day of caching with revalidation after.
